source.instrument: Keysight DSO9104A (1 GHz, 20 GS/s), BNG driver V3.1 backup PCB
source.conditions: poly6 m-sequence, fixed 40 V, 35 degC, symbol width 19-200 ns

caveats: Measured on the backup PCB whose calibration the 27/09/2021 repair superseded (labelled '(Invalid)' in the archive); the label refers to the calibration, not the data. There is no 19 degC counterpart, so nothing here compares temperatures.

Shapes are ensemble means normalised to the step: they show form (overshoot, settling, ringing), not absolute volts. The band is +-1 SD across edges; its count is shown, and at the fastest symbols it is small.

The CMRR prediction uses only the measured channel skew and width mismatch, CMRR = -10 log10(D / 2T). One constant offset is free (+6.3 dB, a factor-of-two convention in the reduction); the shape across rate is a prediction, matching to +-0.43 dB.
DSO9104A bandwidth is 1 GHz: edges near 1 ns carry the scope's own ~0.35 ns step response in quadrature.
